### UC-01 · Customer holds a seat

- **Actor:** Customer · **FR:** FR-01
- **Main flow:** 1. The customer clicks a free seat. 2. The system holds it and starts a countdown.
- **Error flows:** E1 the seat was just taken → toast "This seat was just taken".
- **Related:** FL-01, E-01, [seat map](../08-ux-ui/screens/seat-map.md)
